title: LensMarketView
description: The plural-Mishpat-lens market over one EPR — the lenses governing it, their context-relative affinity, the controversy (contention) spread, the regime-drift status, and any open fresh-lens bounty. Source of truth: assembled read projection (Operational, Category C). Lens identities are DHT-notarized Mishpat Commitments (Category A); affinity, contention, and regimeStatus are reconstructable facing folds over the notarized selection/verdict tallies. Reconstructed per request; not persisted. GET /api/v1/epr/{eprScope}/lens-market.

eprScope.description: The EPR slug-id this market governs (e.g. 'epr:lamad-spa') — the scope key, NOT the dag-cbor CID (plan A3).

lenses.description: The lenses governing this EPR, side by side (plural, co-valid — a shared table of readings, never a ranked leaderboard). Ordered by affinity desc with a deterministic lensCid tie-break; an invalid lens is present with valid=false (degraded row), never dropped.

lensCid.description: The lens entry_hash (= CID, the read/scope key; NEVER action_hash — plan A5 gospel).

school.description: The collective / school-of-thought label (e.g. 'georgist', 'beerian'); feeds the contributor-card attribution.

telosSummary.description: Short human summary of what this lens steers toward (its telos).

affinityInContext.description: Earned affinity in THIS EPR context — distinct attested selectors (gaming-resistant). 0 = warm-but-not-active here (folds::lens_affinity).

currentVerdict.description: This lens's current deterministic reading over the EPR; null when the lens has not yet fired in this context.

valid.description: Fail-closed flag — false means the lens row is degraded (poisoned/unparseable) and excluded from selection, but still surfaced (the EprRouter-empties lesson; plan A5).

contentionIndex.description: Controversy SPREAD over this EPR in [0,1]: 1.0 = perfectly split (max contention), 0.0 = unanimous/none. NOT a net score (folds::lens_contention). Feeds the ControversyBadge.

regimeStatus.description: Cross-surface regime-drift status: 'stable' | 'drifting' | 'breached'. 'breached' is the JOINT affinity-decay AND contention-rise condition (folds::lens_selector::classify_regime — the net-new primitive) that opens a bounty.

openBountyCid.description: Commitment CID of an open fresh-lens pull-bounty for this EPR (opened on a ContentionBreach), or null when none is open.

computedAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp this projection was assembled (Operational-C; reconstructable, not persisted).
